metadata.name: corp_actions
metadata.description: Morro: corporate actions for tokenized bonds on Solana

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Required for on-chain settlement: emptied and closed.

accounts.name: issuer_settlement_account
docs: Receives any escrow remainder (zero when every entitlement was paid).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may push payments once the payment date is reached.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may run the snapshot; the payer only funds the Entitlement account.

instructions.name: transfer_hook
docs: Token-2022 transfer hook: KYC check on the receiver and balance checkpoints.

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: Mint must have 0 decimals and zero supply

errors.name: InvalidMintAuthority
errors.msg: Mint authority must be the bond PDA

errors.name: InvalidTransferHook
errors.msg: Mint transfer hook must point to this program

errors.name: InvalidPermanentDelegate
errors.msg: Mint permanent delegate must be the bond PDA

errors.name: InvalidBondTerms
errors.msg: Invalid bond terms

errors.name: NotIssuer
errors.msg: Signer is not the issuer

errors.name: NotRegistrar
errors.msg: Signer is not the registrar

errors.name: NotPayingAgent
errors.msg: Signer is not the paying agent

errors.name: HolderNotApproved
errors.msg: Holder is not KYC-approved

errors.name: HolderFrozen
errors.msg: Holder is frozen

errors.name: ReceiverNotApproved
errors.msg: Receiver is not a KYC-approved holder

errors.name: BondNotActive
errors.msg: Bond is no longer active

errors.name: TransfersLocked
errors.msg: Transfers are locked for an open redemption

errors.name: NotTransferring
errors.msg: Hook called outside a token transfer

errors.name: InvalidActionParams
errors.msg: Invalid action parameters

errors.name: RecordDateInPast
errors.msg: Record date must be in the future

errors.name: RedemptionAlreadyOpen
errors.msg: Another redemption is already open

errors.name: TooManyOpenActions
errors.msg: Too many actions awaiting a snapshot

errors.name: CheckpointHistoryFull
errors.msg: Balance history is full and still needed by an open record date; finalize that snapshot first

errors.name: RecordDateNotReached
errors.msg: Record date has not passed yet

errors.name: InvalidActionStatus
errors.msg: Action is not in the required state

errors.name: NoBalanceAtRecord
errors.msg: Holder had no bonds at the record date

errors.name: SnapshotIncomplete
errors.msg: Snapshot is incomplete: snapshotted balance does not equal supply at record date

errors.name: NotAPaymentAction
errors.msg: Action does not pay cash

errors.name: WrongSettlementMode
errors.msg: Wrong settlement mode for this instruction

errors.name: PaymentDateNotReached
errors.msg: Payment date has not been reached

errors.name: InvalidEntitlementStatus
errors.msg: Entitlement is not in the required state

errors.name: MissingAccount
errors.msg: A required account is missing

errors.name: WrongTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account does not belong to the holder

errors.name: SettlementIncomplete
errors.msg: Not every entitlement has been settled

errors.name: VotingClosed
errors.msg: Voting is closed

errors.name: VotingOpen
errors.msg: Voting is still open

errors.name: AlreadyVoted
errors.msg: Holder has already voted

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

fields.name: face_value
docs: Face value per bond, in settlement-token minor units (tiyn).

fields.name: transfer_lock_ts
docs: Non-zero while a redemption is open: transfers are rejected from this time on.

fields.name: pending_record_ts
docs: Record dates whose snapshot is not finalized yet (0 = empty slot).

types.name: Checkpoints
docs: Time-ordered history of a value (a holder's balance or the bond's supply).

fields.name: period_start_ts
docs: Coupon accrual period; equal values mean no coupon (e.g. partial redemption).

fields.name: redeem_bps
docs: Share of each holding retired, in bps (10,000 for a full redemption).

fields.name: amount
docs: Cash owed, in settlement-token minor units.
